Two steps and common visible alternatives fit usor. No author name, literary date or specialist plot recall is required. Direct target move remains illegal and the path uses the existing directed graph.

An everyday carried object reaches a named story via either the book or its reader. The arc is small but satisfying as a beginner lesson in associations; it is not evidence of a deep or difficult puzzle.
